topic: Dropping the Car Off for an Oil Change

script.title: THE OIL CHANGE WAIT
script.story_hook: One oil change, forty minutes, and a small lobby.
script.intro_zh: 一次換機油，四十分鐘，還有間小得可憐的休息廳。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to the service counter today. Listen for waiting-room small talk.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到今天的維修站櫃臺。留意等待時的閒聊話語。
script.outro: Sixty lines, one oil change, done. Listen again and repeat out loud.
script.outro_zh: 六十句對白，一次保養，完成。再聽一遍，大聲跟著說。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.title_quote: It always feels fancy at first
script.char_a_description: a heavyset man in his fifties with closely cropped salt-and-pepper hair, rectangular reading glasses, a navy fleece vest over a light blue oxford shirt, khaki pants, and work boots
script.char_b_description: a lean young man in his twenties with a dark brown skin fade haircut, a thin beard, a grey shop polo with an orange name patch, a key ring at his belt, and scuffed sneakers

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Morning. Do you still take walk-ins today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɔɹnɪŋ du ju stɪl teɪk ˈwɑk ɪnz təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 早。請問今天還收不用預約的車嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We do, though the last slot just opened up.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi du ðoʊ ðə læst slɑt dʒʌst ˈoʊpənd ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 收，不過最後一個時段剛剛才空出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, it's just a plain oil change.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt ɪts dʒʌst ə pleɪn ɔɪl tʃeɪndʒ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，就是最普通的那種換機油。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure thing. What do you drive?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃʊɹ θɪŋ wʌt du ju dɹaɪv/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。您開的是什麼車？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: An older SUV, four cylinders, nothing fancy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ən ˈoʊldɚ ˌɛs ju ˈvi fɔɹ ˈsɪləndɚz ˈnʌθɪŋ ˈfænsi/
dialogue.zh: 一輛有些年頭的休旅車，四缸，很普通的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What mileage are we at these days?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ˈmaɪlɪdʒ ɑɹ wi æt ðiz deɪz/
dialogue.zh: 現在大概跑了多少里程了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, one hundred forty thousand, sadly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm wʌn ˈhʌndɚd ˈfɔɹti ˈθaʊzənd ˈsædli/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，十四萬英里了，說起來有點傷心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hey, that's honestly a good runner.
dialogue.phonetic: /heɪ ðæts ˈɑnəstli ə ɡʊd ˈɹʌnɚ/
dialogue.zh: 嘿，說實話這車已經很爭氣了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, it starts every single morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ɪt stɑɹts ˈɛvɹi ˈsɪŋɡəl ˈmɔɹnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 也是，起碼每天早上都發動得起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So, regular oil or the synthetic kind?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈɹɛɡjəlɚ ɔɪl ɔɹ ðə sɪnˈθɛtɪk kaɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 那，要用普通機油還是合成機油？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: To be honest, I don't know the difference.
dialogue.phonetic: /tə bi ˈɑnəst aɪ doʊnt noʊ ðə ˈdɪfɹəns/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，我搞不懂兩者有什麼差別。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Synthetic lasts longer in bad weather.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪnˈθɛtɪk lɑsts ˈlɔŋɡɚ ɪn bæd ˈwɛðɚ/
dialogue.zh: 合成機油在天氣差的時候撐得更久。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, that matters, winter gets brutal here.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðæt ˈmæɾɚz ˈwɪnɚ ɡɛts ˈbɹuɾəl hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 噢，那就有關係了，這邊的冬天很難熬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then take synthetic, it's only nine dollars more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn teɪk sɪnˈθɛtɪk ɪts ˈoʊnli naɪn ˈdɑlɚz mɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 那就用合成的吧，只貴九塊錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deal. Also, how much oil does it take?
dialogue.phonetic: /dil ˈɔlsoʊ haʊ mʌtʃ ɔɪl dʌz ɪt teɪk/
dialogue.zh: 成交。對了，這車要加多少機油？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About five quarts, so the price holds.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt faɪv kwɔɹts soʊ ðə pɹaɪs hoʊldz/
dialogue.zh: 大約五夸脫，所以報價不變。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Can you check the tires too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt kən ju tʃɛk ðə ˈtaɪɚz tu/
dialogue.zh: 好極了。可以順便幫我看看輪胎嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, we add air for free with every oil change.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ wi æd ɛɹ fɚ fɹi wɪð ˈɛvɹi ɔɪl tʃeɪndʒ/
dialogue.zh: 當然，每次換機油我們都免費補氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice, the left rear always looks a little low.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs ðə lɛft ɹɪɹ ˈɔlweɪz lʊks ə ˈlɪɾəl loʊ/
dialogue.zh: 不錯，左後那條胎看起來總是有點扁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll flag it, might be a slow leak.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl flæɡ ɪt maɪt bi ə sloʊ lik/
dialogue.zh: 我會標記起來，說不定是慢漏氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, when did you last patch that tire?
dialogue.phonetic: /həm wɛn dɪd ju læst pætʃ ðæt taɪɚ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，上次補那條胎是什麼時候？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Last spring, at this very counter.
dialogue.phonetic: /læst spɹɪŋ æt ðɪs ˈvɛɹi ˈkaʊɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 去年春天，就在這個櫃臺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right, I forgot, small world, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt aɪ fɚˈɡɑt smɔl wɝld hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 想起來了，我差點忘了，世界真小，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Also, your air filter looks pretty gray.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlsoʊ jɔɹ ɛɹ ˈfɪlɚ lʊks ˈpɹɪti ɡɹeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 還有，您的空氣濾芯看起來已經挺髒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that something I should worry about?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt ˈsʌmθɪŋ aɪ ʃʊd ˈwɝɹi əˈbaʊt/
dialogue.zh: 這個問題嚴重到需要擔心嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not an emergency, but replace it soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ən ɪˈmɝdʒəns bʌt ɹɪˈpleɪs ɪt sun/
dialogue.zh: 算不上緊急，不過很快要換。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much for a new filter installed?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ fɚ ə nu ˈfɪlɚ ɪnˈstɔld/
dialogue.zh: 換新濾芯連安裝要多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty-four, and it takes two minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti fɔɹ ænd ɪt teɪks tu ˈmɪnəts/
dialogue.zh: 二十四塊，而且兩分鐘就裝好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, um, not today, my budget says no.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ʌm nɑt təˈdeɪ maɪ ˈbʌdʒɪt sɛz noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 這個嘛，嗯，今天先不了，錢包說不行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Totally fair, no rush at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtoʊɾəli fɛɹ noʊ ɹʌʃ æt ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 完全合理，一點也不急。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, noted, now about today's timing.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈnoʊtɪd naʊ əˈbaʊt təˈdeɪz ˈtaɪmɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，記下了。先說說今天的時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forty minutes, if the bay stays clear.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔɹti ˈmɪnəts ɪf ðə beɪ steɪz klɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 四十分鐘，假設工作區騰得開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I wait, or come back later?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ weɪt ɔɹ kʌm bæk ˈleɪɚ/
dialogue.zh: 我該留在這等，還是晚點再來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Waiting's fine, we have coffee and magazines.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈweɪtɪŋz faɪn wi hæv ˈkɔfi ænd ˌmæɡəˈziːnz/
dialogue.zh: 等也挺好的，我們有咖啡和雜誌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, is that coffee fresh or ancient?
dialogue.phonetic: /həm ɪz ðæt ˈkɔfɪ fɹɛʃ ɔɹ ˈeɪnʃənt/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，那咖啡是新煮的還是泡了一輩子的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Honestly? Older than both of us combined.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑnəstli ˈoʊldɚ ðæn boʊθ ʌv ʌs kəmˈbaɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 老實說？比咱倆加起來還有年頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, then bring me a cup anyway, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ðɛn brɪŋ mi ə kʌp ˈɛniˌweɪ pliz/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，那還是麻煩給我來一杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On it. Keys, and a quick look outside?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ɪt kiz ænd ə kwɪk lʊk ˌaʊtˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 好的。鑰匙給我，再快速看一眼車外？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Go ahead, scratch on the bumper's already there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ əˈhɛd skætʃ ɑn ðə ˈbʌmpɚz ɔlˈrɛdi ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 看吧，保險槓上那道刮痕本來就在。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep, I'll note it, no surprises later.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp aɪl ˈnoʊt ɪt noʊ sɚˈpɹaɪsəz ˈleɪɚ/
dialogue.zh: 好，我會記錄下來，省得事後有爭議。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You people are wiser than my cousin.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ˈpipəl ɑɹ ˈwaɪzɚ ðæn maɪ ˈkʌzən/
dialogue.zh: 你們做事比我表哥細心多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bet he skipped the notes once, poor guy.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɛt hi skɪpt ðə ˈnoʊts wʌns pɔɹ ɡaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我猜他吃過沒記錄的虧，可憐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly that kind of story, sadly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ðæt kaɪnd əv ˈstɔɹi ˈsædli/
dialogue.zh: 可不是嘛，就是那種傷心的往事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sir, your car is on the lift already.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɝ jɔɹ kɑɹ ɪz ɑn ðə lɪft ɔlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 先生，您的車已經上舉升機了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That was fast, I didn't even finish coffee.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wəz fæst aɪ ˈdɪdənt ˈiːvən ˈfɪnɪʃ ˈkɔfi/
dialogue.zh: 好快，我咖啡都還沒喝完。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We're good, oil's in, tires topped up.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪɹ ɡʊd ɔɪlz ɪn taɪɚz ˈtɑpt ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 都弄好了，機油換好，胎壓也補滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? That's quicker than the barber.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹɪli ðæts ˈkwɪkɚ ðæn ðə ˈbɑɹbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？比理髮師還快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow day, you got lucky, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /sloʊ deɪ ju ɡɑt ˈlʌki ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 今天生意淡，說實話您運氣好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much do I owe for all of this?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ du aɪ oʊ fɔɹ ɔl əv ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 這一切總共要付多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sixty-two, tax is already included.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪksti tu ˈtæks ɪz ɔlˈrɛdi ɪnˈkluːdɪd/
dialogue.zh: 六十二塊，稅已經算在裡面了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Card okay? The machine here judges me.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑɹd ˈoʊkeɪ ðə məˈʃin hɪɹ dʒʌdʒɪz mi/
dialogue.zh: 刷卡可以嗎？這臺機器總是為難我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It always feels fancy at first, then beeps.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈɔlweɪz filz ˈfænsi æt fɝst ðɛn bips/
dialogue.zh: 它一開始總裝得很高級，然後就嗶了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, look at that, it accepted me.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ lʊk æt ðæt ɪt ɛkˈsɛptɪd mi/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，你看，它居然肯收我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Receipt by text, or paper like old times?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹɪˈsit baɪ tɛkst ɔɹ ˈpeɪpɚ laɪk oʊld taɪmz/
dialogue.zh: 收據傳簡訊，還是像從前給紙本？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Text it, my glove box eats paper.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛkst ɪt maɪ ɡlʌv bɑks its ˈpeɪpɚ/
dialogue.zh: 傳簡訊吧，我的置物箱會吃掉紙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next service is three months out, easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst ˈsɝvɪs ɪz θɹi mʌnts aʊt ˈizi/
dialogue.zh: 下次保養在三個月後，不急。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put me down, I trust this counter now.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt mi daʊn aɪ tɹʌst ðɪs ˈkaʊɾɪɹ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 那就預約吧，我現在信得過這個櫃臺。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done. Drive safe, big customer.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn dɹaɪv seɪf bɪɡ ˈkʌstəməɚ/
dialogue.zh: 搞定。路上慢開，大客戶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for the honest advice today.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks fɚ ði ˈɑnəst ædˈvaɪs təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你今天誠懇的建議。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime, next round of coffee is better.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniˌtaɪm nɛkst raʊnd əv ˈkɔfi ɪz ˈbɛɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣，下次那壺咖啡會更新鮮。

script.youtube_title: 【換機油喝咖啡☕】「它居然肯收我」完整保養對話🚗🔧🎧｜聽完就會自己進廠｜60句美語聽力練習｜Oil Change at the Garage
script.youtube_title_en: "It Always Feels Fancy at First" — A Full Oil Change at the Garage
script.youtube_description:
「它居然肯收我」——把車開進保養廠，怎麼問價位、選機油、順便檢查輪胎？這一集是 60 句美式英語聽力練習，場景就在修車店的服務櫃臺前。

你會聽到：從報里程數、普通機油與合成機油的選擇，到濾芯報價的婉拒話術；還有免費補氣、記錄舊刮痕、休息廳咖啡的玩笑，以及刷卡機鬧脾氣時的實用回應。

整段對話維持 A2 初級程度的短句與高頻單字，充滿美國人日常的真實語感：um、well、so、ha、honestly。聽完你就會用：How much do I owe?、Should I wait, or come back later?、Put me down、Anytime。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著念，讓舌頭先跟上，腦袋自然就會了。

不用背單字，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡請訂閱並開啟小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"It always feels fancy at first" — how do you actually talk at the oil change counter? This 60-line English listening practice takes you inside a real American garage service desk.

You will hear: reporting mileage, choosing regular versus synthetic oil, politely declining a filter upsell, free tire air, scratch notes on the bumper, and the moody card machine that finally beeps.

Every line stays at A2 level with the fillers Americans really use: um, well, so, ha, honestly. By the end you'll own phrases like How much do I owe?, Should I wait, or come back later?, Put me down, and Anytime.

The final chapter is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud while the oil drains.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🎧汽車保養英文｜選合成機油・問里程・刷卡機鬧脾氣｜聽完就會自己進廠｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
車開進保養廠，機油要選普通的還是合成的？師傅問里程數，你聽得懂嗎？店家推銷濾芯時，怎麼禮貌地說不？

這一集帶大家來到美式修車店的服務櫃臺，從報名單、選機油、檢查輪胎，一路聽到結帳與道別，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🚗 報里程：Um, one hundred forty thousand, sadly.
🛢️ 選機油：So, regular oil or the synthetic kind?
💳 刷卡句：Card okay? The machine here judges me.
📝 約下次：Put me down, I trust this counter now.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、well、so 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著這四十分鐘的等待走完一趟，下次你的車進廠，你也能從容對話。

祝你下次保養，咖啡是新鮮的。
